item.title: ConformTXT 0.6.22
item.description: - ⌃⌘V beeps every time it can't swap, including the first press (before, the first press could do nothing silently). - After a swap that undid the matched paste but couldn't finish, the next ⌃⌘V pastes the original instead of beeping. - ChatGPT's link chips (which ChatGPT copies without their links) no longer leave a double space behind.
